doc: world/feed-ui.md is canonical for behavior + copy. This file is the machine-readable mirror: spectator-feed event schema, event vocabulary, and the demo seed set used by feed.html. The spectator feed is FREE forever (design §5) — it is the product's top of funnel, never metered.

event_schema.who: optional character id (C1–C8, A01–A20) or player handle on request events
event_schema.text: display text — surface-level only; never quotes interiors of homes, never secrets
event_schema.status: request events only: one of request_status
event_schema.req: optional, request events: shared request id — every lifecycle event of one paid intervention carries it; detail views group the status trail on it
event_schema.reason_code: optional, denied requests only: fixed enum from world/moderation.json (public sees the why-class, never the screened text beyond the display filter)
event_schema.attrs: optional: { surge, credits, minutes, compensated_cr, sponsors[], mentions[] } for transparency lines and follow matching; credits+minutes = the declared cost/duration shown at filing (design §11: action + duration declared upfront)

spectator_ui.doc: world v19 — the full spectator surface (world/wire.html, spec world/wire-ui.md). feed.html remains the lightweight variant.
spectator_ui.permalink: #e=<event id> deep-links one event; ids are stable live → archive (same id resolves in The Archive next day)
spectator_ui.request_threading: events sharing `req` render as one lifecycle trail (requested → in_review → approved → running → resolved/refunded/not approved)

follow_targets.v:<venue_id>: pin a venue — free spectator filter, reversible
follow_targets.c:<char_id>: pin a character (C/A/h ids) — public whereabouts only; a filter, never control

pagination.older: 'load older' extends the page in place — never a scroll jump
pagination.caught_up: 'You're caught up — nothing older than this today.'; earlier days route to The Archive
pagination.new_events: scrolled-away viewers see 'N new — jump to top'; the stream never moves text under a reader

spectator_ui_v33.doc: world v33 — lean-back + control polish on wire.html. Everything is view-layer only; no key, button, or pin can touch the world.
spectator_ui_v33.zen: lean-back theater view (button, `z` key, `#z=1`) — rails/upsell off, stream enlarged; view-layer only
spectator_ui_v33.hold: freezes the DISPLAY, never the world — events keep accruing behind an honest backlog bar ('the world didn't pause; the display did'); click or `h` releases
spectator_ui_v33.reaching_in_now: strip of live request cards (latest status ∈ requested/in_review/approved/queued/running) + recent admin actions, all attributed; a card opens the request's trail
spectator_ui_v33.keyboard: j/k select · enter detail · / search · f following · z zen · h hold · esc back out · ? help card
spectator_ui_v33.request_permalink: #r=<req> deep-links a request — resolves to the newest event in its lifecycle trail
spectator_ui_v33.mentions_ui: attrs.mentions[] render as pinnable chips in the detail panel; event who/venue get 'pin' buttons (view-layer follows only)

spectator_ui_v47.doc: world v47 — the recap layer on wire.html (v4). Still strictly view-layer: every number below is the feed's own events counted, never invented and never editorial.
spectator_ui_v47.day_so_far: collapsible card ('the day so far' bar / `d` key) — window covered, event count, busiest venue, requests filed/open/closed, weather changes, admin actions + total compensated credits; footer note states it is the wire counted, not a ranking
spectator_ui_v47.missed_bar: on join, a dismissible 'earlier today' bar summarizes everything already on the wire (count, requests, admin actions, latest sky) + 'catch me up' scrolls to the oldest pre-join event; pre-join timestamps render dimmed. No persistence, no fabricated personalization — it describes the feed as it stood at arrival
spectator_ui_v47.declared_costs: request rows carry 'N cr · M min' and the detail panel adds 'declared — N cr · M min (paid upfront, hard cap — shown at filing)' from attrs.credits/minutes; the price was public at filing and the wire repeats it
spectator_ui_v47.wx_follows_feed: the header weather line is set by the newest `weather` event (icon guessed from the event's own words — fog/rain/sun/wind/cloud); no fabricated temperature. Applies in demo and live modes alike

spectator_ui_v61.doc: world v61 — the Director's rail on wire.html (v5). A free preview of the paid view-layer Director pass; still strictly view-layer — no preset, cam, or scrub touches the world, and the page carries no purchase affordance (the pass is filed at the Counter like any request).
spectator_ui_v61.director_bar: collapsible bar between the day card and the stream (#dirbar; Preview button, `v` key, `#dir=1`); persisted per-viewer under rw_wire_cam; hidden in zen
spectator_ui_v61.cam_presets: named presets (park lawn / café row / the strip / clarion alley / the night shift) map to venue sets — matching rows get a gold edge (.camhl); a camera MARKS the wire, never filters it
spectator_ui_v61.follow_cam: selector over mains + ambients + hired residents — rows whose who/mentions hit the follow-cam get the gold edge; labeled 'public whereabouts only'; a follow-cam is a pin on visibility the camera already has, never new coverage
spectator_ui_v61.replay_scrub: range slider spanning today's wire window [earliest event .. now]; scrubbing shows 'the wire at HH:MM' — the newest events at-or-before that minute, verbatim. It replays the feed's own record; the copy says 'the feed, replayed — the world itself kept running.'
spectator_ui_v61.live_receipt: request detail gains a 'live record' line from BRIDGE.gsExplainRequest(req) when the bus offers it — status/claim/declared cost/trail count, rendered defensively
spectator_ui_v61.live_occupancy: venue cards read BRIDGE.gsOccupancy() or gsViewerState().occupancy when offered ({mains,labels,count} per venue); absent, the public-routine picture stands
spectator_ui_v61.pass_pointer: the Director pass (10 cr/30 min, plan §2.3 PROPOSAL) is pointed at, never sold — 'filed at the Counter like any request' links to request.html
spectator_ui_v61.keyboard: adds `v` — toggle the director bar; esc closes it before clearing selection

spectator_ui_v75.doc: world v75 — the schedule + the person layer on wire.html (v6). Still strictly view-layer: a booked window is read, never filed here; a mute is the viewer's own display, never the record; a character card counts the wire, never the person.
spectator_ui_v75.book_strip: collapsible 'on the book' bar (#bookbar, `b` key, persisted rw_wire_book) between the live strip and the missed bar — upcoming booked windows (HH:MM · claim · what · holder handle) from an inline BOOKW mirror of bookings.json windows plus, live, gsViewerState().calendar merged deduped by claim+start (start_min or HH:MM accepted). Only windows still ahead of the block clock render — a fired window is already a wire event. Footer links the Book; no prices, no slot-claim affordance — the wire reads the calendar, it never writes it
spectator_ui_v75.char_day: 'their wire today' card (#cday, right rail) — click a cast-strip name or the button on a character's event record; lists every event whose who/attrs.mentions touched them today (newest 8 + an honest remainder count), with the same pin affordance and the standing honesty line 'public whereabouts only — homes are walls; off-the-feed stretches stay off'. Counted from the wire — no invented activity
spectator_ui_v75.thread_mute: request detail gains 'mute this thread' — that req's lines drop out of the stream and the live-now strip on this viewer's screen only (rw_wire_mute, reversible from the muted list in the Following panel); copy states the wire's record is unchanged and The Archive keeps everything. Muted rows still count in the day card — the recap counts the wire, not your view of it
spectator_ui_v75.search_count: the search box gains a live 'N matching' counter (#qcount) over the whole feed (text + who + resolved names + venue names) — an honest count, never a ranking

spectator_ui_v89.doc: world v89 — the real wire seam on wire.html (v7). The page now reads the bus's own wire shape (41_game_systems_feed / gsWireTail) instead of a guessed v6 contract; every read is capability-detected and the demo pipeline stands when the bus is absent.
spectator_ui_v89.live_shape: entries carry {id, n (monotonic feed order — used as seq), t (PT minute-of-day), day (PT date → multi-day separators), kind, text, venue, who, req, status, reason_code, attempt (denied asks show the class only), mentions (top-level — folded into attrs.mentions for the renderers), attrs:{credits, compensated_cr, surge, discount}}
spectator_ui_v89.incremental_sync: after the join tail, polls prefer BRIDGE.gsWireSince(maxN) — a 50-line tail can't drop events on a busy day; 'load older' calls BRIDGE.gsWirePage({before:oldestN, limit}) and ends at an honest 'top of the record' line
spectator_ui_v89.live_clock: the block clock follows real PT wall time (America/Los_Angeles) live — daypart label, book-strip 'still ahead' filter, and admin-recency are true
spectator_ui_v89.permit_board: right-rail panel reads vs.board / gsResourceBoard() — per-claim public state (free/cool/locked/queued + honest times + booked[] markers); read-only, claims are filed at the Counter never here
spectator_ui_v89.co_sessions: vs.sessions / gsCoSessions() pairs ride the reaching-in-now strip as 'a + b · one scene' cards — the same overlaps the bus logs 'session' feed events for
spectator_ui_v89.wx_sponsors: vs.weather {wx, untilMin, sponsors} sets the header line 'player-called sky — <wx> until HH:MM · N sponsors'
spectator_ui_v89.wire_stats: gsWireStats() real shape {total, suppressed, displayFilter, byKind...}: suppressed count renders in the day card as 'withheld — privacy screens, not downtime'; the viewer counter only displays if the bus reports one (no invented audience)
spectator_ui_v89.explain: gsExplainRequest real shape {note, queuePos, blockedBy[], behind[], on[] claim labels, code} renders as 'the bus says — <note>' + waiting-on/blocked-by lines
spectator_ui_v89.booked_status: 'booked' (a scheduled-window status on bus-forwarded entries, v88 seam) gets a chip style and counts as open on the live strip; the 10 canonical request_status values are unchanged
spectator_ui_v89.follow_sync: pins write through to BRIDGE.gsWireFollow with bus keys (v:<venue> / m:<char>) — the ONLY write a spectator surface ever makes, and it's the viewer's own pin

spectator_ui_v103.doc: world v103 — the record layer on wire.html (v8). The last bus endpoints get honest surfaces; still strictly view-layer.
spectator_ui_v103.pin_readback: BRIDGE.gsWireFollows() hydrates the Following panel: bus keys v:<venue>/m:<char> map to page v:/c:; each poll adopts bus-side pins set elsewhere; first sync pushes page pins the bus lacks once; unpins never resurrect
spectator_ui_v103.archive_depth: BRIDGE.gsWireDays() drives the footer link — 'N days on record → The Archive' when the record spans >1 day; honest count, no guessed history
spectator_ui_v103.vocab_coverage: BRIDGE.gsWireVocabulary() (kinds/statuses/reasonCodes) caches as LIVE_VOCAB; the day card reports 'M of S statuses seen today' — coverage counted from the wire itself
spectator_ui_v103.self_check: BRIDGE.gsWireAudit() runs on day-card open (not per-poll): 'the bus's self-check — N lines · self-check ok' or the honest issue count; issues are counted, never quoted
spectator_ui_v103.keyboard: unchanged — d still toggles the day card and now also refreshes the self-check live

event_kinds: a named character changes venue (arrivals/departures — public routine only)
crowd-level note: fills, empties, line out the door
sky changes — including player-called weather, attributed
a player request lifecycle event (attributed — design §5 public request feed)
owner/admin action, always attributed, always with compensation note
Mission Unfiltered blog post — the blog is public; the author is a secret and never named
public registry events: move-in, listing posted/filled (never terms beyond posted rent)
a hired character joins the block — attributed to the hiring player; bio text only post-screen
honest-empty marker for dead dayparts — the feed may go quiet and says so
display_rules: surface-only: feed text is what a camera on the street could verify — no thoughts, no dialogue, no home interiors
homes render as 'home'/'headed home' — residential interiors are never a feed surface
secrets/drama seeds cannot appear: they are absent from the feed schema (structural, not filtered)
request text shown verbatim only after the §11 screen passes; denied text is never displayed
admin actions always carry compensation detail when players were affected
Mission Unfiltered posts carry no author — the author is a C1 secret and the feed does not speculate
viewer counts and timestamps are honest — no inflated social proof (no dark patterns)
